description: This file contains UI component classes for the User Detail page in the Mattermost system console, including modals, user card, team panel, and interactions for testing with Playwright.

classes.name: SaveChangesModal
classes.description: Represents the confirmation modal shown when saving user detail changes.

classes.name: UserDetail
classes.description: Main class for interacting with the User Detail page, including header, user card, team panel, and save/cancel actions.

classes.name: AdminUserCard
classes.description: Component class for the user information card, including user details and action buttons.

classes.name: TeamMembershipPanel
classes.description: Component class for managing and displaying team memberships for a user.

methods.name: getChanges
methods.description: Retrieves the list of change summaries shown in the Save Changes modal.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the UserDetail component is visible.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Clicks the back link to navigate away from the User Detail page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Clicks the save button to save user changes.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Clicks the cancel button to discard changes.

methods.name: waitForSaveComplete
methods.description: Waits until the save button is disabled, indicating save completion.
